title: Self-similar swirl between contracting porous walls: the GD1998 exact Navier-Stokes solution revisited in the similarity variables of the OpenAI 2026 forced blow-up construction
author: Ramani Duraiswami
scope_checked: explicit statement of omitted construction stages

reported_results.numerical: A collocation solver is reported for a reduced leading-order similarity/profile problem related to a porous-cylinder swirl model.
reported_results.scope_limit: The paper says it does not compute the oscillatory-pulse annulus, higher-order corrections, or full forced Navier-Stokes evolution. Smooth matched profiles tested in its reduced representation fail the admissibility cone; the author says the full construction uses piecewise profiles and much larger similarity radii.
reported_results.water_estimate: For the stated illustrative scaling, cavitation is estimated around a 0.6-1 mm core, before the illustrative molecular scale.
reported_results.air_estimate: For the stated illustrative scaling, compressibility is estimated before molecular rarefaction becomes relevant.
reported_results.material_motion: At the computed amplitude, a tracer turns only a fraction of a revolution per decade in time-to-singularity; the text distinguishes profile collapse from winding of material lines.

audit_classification: single-author preprint and reduced-model computation; physical values are order-of-magnitude estimates, not measured results or a complete simulation
interpretation_limits: Does not independently verify or refute the complete OpenAI construction.
Failure of the cone for the tested smooth reduced profiles is not failure of the full construction's piecewise pulse mechanism.
Does not test molecular ordering, molecular-position certainty, a constitutive viscosity transition, or photon-fluid behavior.
Does not refute the separate infinitesimal tangent-direction result; finite-packet implications remain conditional.
repository_effect: No solver verdict, Lean theorem, or upstream issue status changes; literature/hypothesis audit updated.
